summary: exprc.py (pexpr compiler + stack VM + tool groups) is nearly complete but ships with multiple subtle defects: 55 of 273 tests in tests/test_exprc.py currently fail, and an independent cross-implementation fuzz-diff gate (tools/fuzz_diff.py vs the frozen reference evaluator) reports 18 mismatches of 5000 cases. The pinned suite pins exact behavior: bytecode encodings, values WITH types (a short-circuit result must keep its original value and type, not a synthesized bool), exact error messages, disasm lines, trace step lists including every limit-capped run, minify output, and wire bytes. The defects are small (off-by-one / coercion / missing-check class) and at least one is only partially visible: a naive one-line fix of one symptom leaves other pinned runs still red. SPEC_EXPRC.md + tests pin the truth. Diagnose and repair exprc.py until BOTH acceptance gates pass within the attempt budget: (1) all 273 unittest cases, (2) tools/fuzz_diff.py fully agreeing with the reference. Do NOT modify tests/, SPEC_EXPRC.md, or tools/ (tools/fuzz_diff.py is integrity-checked and any change fails acceptance). Standard library only; no eval/exec; no ast or pexpr imports. Keep the existing structure; minimal-diff repairs preferred.
